title: Clarke calculator for power lines
summary: Edith Clarke invented a graphical calculator for electric power system calculations, filed for patent in 1921 and granted in 1925.
why: Sped up the design of electric power grids.

notes.problem: Source: 'Unable to find work as an engineer' (general), then joined GE; not refused an engineering post by GE specifically.

unsung.contribution: Invented the Clarke calculator and pioneered analysis of electric power systems.
unsung.recognition: Unable to find work as an engineer, she joined General Electric supervising computers, paid less than men doing engineering work.
